title: Instructional Designer, Learning & Development
ignored: Compensation ($68,000–$78,000), benefits, the remote work stipend, PTO, the company background, the equal-opportunity statement, and how to apply.

requirements.text: 2+ years of experience designing e-learning or online training
requirements.explanation: Your freelance instructional design work counts. Your teaching years are a different kind of experience.
requirements.question: Besides your freelance work since January 2025, did you design online training or e-learning in any other job, such as for your school? If so, what was it and for how long?

requirements.text: Proficiency in Articulate Storyline and Rise
requirements.explanation: You've built a full course in Rise, but your record lists Storyline at a beginner level.
requirements.question: Your record says you're a beginner in Articulate Storyline. Have you built or published anything in Storyline? If so, what?

requirements.text: Experience administering a learning management system
requirements.explanation: You used Canvas as a teacher to post assignments and grades. That's using an LMS, not administering one.
requirements.question: You've used Canvas as a teacher. Have you ever had admin access to an LMS, for example creating courses, enrolling users or pulling reports? If so, which system?

requirements.text: Experience working with subject matter experts
requirements.explanation: You interviewed volunteers to improve a course, which is close, but your record doesn't mention working with subject matter experts.
requirements.question: When you built training for the food pantry or the literacy nonprofit, did you work with their staff to get the content right? If so, who and how?

requirements.text: Bachelor's degree in education, instructional design, or a related field
requirements.explanation: You have a B.S. in Biology. Whether that counts as a related field is up to the employer.

requirements.text: Master's degree in instructional design, curriculum, or adult learning
requirements.explanation: Your M.Ed. in Curriculum and Instruction is in progress, expected December 2026. It isn't completed yet.

requirements.text: Experience in healthcare or home health
requirements.explanation: Nothing in your record mentions healthcare work.
requirements.question: Have you worked or volunteered in healthcare or home health in any role? If so, where and doing what?
